product.summary: Current Guarda non-custodial wallet application distributed across browser, desktop and mobile environments.
product.notes: The current product is modeled as one multi-platform application lineage. Its exact transition from the original 2017 Ethereum wallet to today's multi-currency form is not given a fabricated product launch date.

events.title: Guarda Mobile Multiwallet released
events.description: Guarda released its Mobile Multiwallet on 2018-12-04 as a universal multi-coin mobile wallet, extending the earlier Guarda wallet lineage into a concrete multi-currency mobile product milestone.
events.notes: This is a later multi-currency mobile milestone, not the initial launch of the Guarda wallet lineage. Guarda's first-party history separately states that its first Ethereum wallet launched in 2017, so wlr_prod_000082 launch_date remains unresolved rather than being backdated or reset to this 2018 release.

evidence.title: Why Guarda? | About Us
evidence.notes: Current first-party about page describes Guarda as non-custodial and available through browser, desktop operating systems and iOS/Android.

evidence.title: Mobile Multiwallet release
evidence.notes: First-party Guarda release post introducing the universal multi-coin Mobile Multiwallet on 2018-12-04. This source is not used to replace the earlier 2017 single-currency Guarda lineage.
